Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That's it we have from this one-sided affair! The Kiwis have secured the T20I series as well. But we still have one game to go and Ireland will be eager to get over the line in that game and finish the series with a smile! The third T20I will be played on Friday, 22nd of July. The game is all set to begin at 8.30 pm IST (3.00 pm GMT). But as you all know our build-up will begin in advance. Do join us then. For now, it's goodbye!

Mitchell Santner, the skipper of New Zealand says that it was a clinical victory, the wicket looked a bit up and down, but the way Dane Cleaver played was outstanding. On Michael Bracewell, he says that there is not a lot that he cannot do at the moment in any format of the game. Ends by saying that he is really happy with this win.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland says that they were never in the game while chasing the target. Mentions that it was just their batting that let them down, and they need to take responsibility. Says that they have come close to them in the ODIs but they have not been playing their best cricket in T20Is, however, they still have one more match to go and they will try to get over the line. Concludes by saying that they have some good teams coming over to Ireland before the World Cup and they have to keep improving day in and day out.

Dane Cleaver is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his unbeaten knock of 78 from just 55 balls! He says that it's a special day and he is happy that he contributed to the win. Mentions that the wicket offered a bit of variation. Says that it was not his most fluent innings but he stuck to his plans. Adds that there is nothing more pleasing for him to play for his country and to contribute to a victory.
Presentation time...

Earlier in the game, the Irish skipper surprisingly decided to bowl first and that did backfire in the end. New Zealand posted a healthy score of 179 on the board courtesy of an unbeaten maiden fifty by Dane Cleaver and handy cameos from the other players. Ireland did bowl well in the death but it was a tough task ahead of them after the first half and they ended up crumbling under pressure.

New Zealand had history behind them as chasing on this ground has always been difficult. However, one needs to execute on the field to get results, and the Kiwis did that to perfection. Lockie Ferguson got the big wicket of Paul Stirling and then two wickets from Jacob Duffy and a run out from Glenn Phillips brought them right on top of this game. Ish Sodhi came into the attack and just killed the chase by taking three wickets in quick succession and Michael Bracewell provided the icing on the cake with a hat-trick to wrap things up.

The chase of 180 was always going to be a stiff one but it was never impossible to do so. However, Ireland just could not show up with the bat in this game. Paul Stirling started off on a positive note but once he departed in the third over, things started going downhill and Ireland went on to lose four wickets in the Powerplay. The hosts were always behind the 8-ball after that and they kept losing wickets. As a result, they folded out for just 91. Mark Adair played an entertaining knock of 27 towards the back end but there was nothing much from the other batters.

The Kiwis have sealed this game and this series with a dominating win! Ireland have been completely outplayed. After a decent show in the ODI series, they have not been able to challenge New Zealand in the T20I series so far.

OUT! CAUGHT! YES, HE CAN! Hat-trick for Michael Bracewell! He finishes things off in style! Short and wide of off. Craig Young backs away and slices it towards backward point. Ish Sodhi there jumps and takes a good catch to complete Michael Bracewell's hat-trick and to wrap the match up! New Zealand win by 88 runs and seal the series 2-0!
Commentary.Howout: c Ish Sodhi b Michael Bracewell

Commentary.Commentary: Can Michael Bracewell get a hat-trick? It has been a dream tour for him so far and it is now time to make it even special. Here we go...
Josh Little is the last batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets in two balls from Michael Bracewell! A similar dismissal like the previous one! A short one, outside off. Barry McCarthy gets low and smashes it towards deep mid-wicket. Glenn Phillips takes a good catch. Michael Bracewell is on a hat-trick now!
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Michael Bracewell

Commentary.Commentary: Craig Young makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Michael Bracewell gets rid of Mark Adair! A flatter delivery on middle. Mark Adair shimmies down the track and whips it off his legs but does not get enough power behind the shot and ends up hitting it straight down the throat of Glenn Phillips at deep mid-wicket. It has been a fine knock from Adair but the party is over now.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Michael Bracewell

Commentary.Commentary: A flatter one on middle. Barry McCarthy works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary for Ireland! A tossed up delivery on middle. Barry McCarthy slog-sweeps it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.

FOUR! New Zealand have been sloppy in the field in the last few overs! It is a short delivery on off. Mark Adair pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Glenn Phillips moves to his left and slides to stop it. However, the ball deflects off his body and goes towards the fence.
Back of a length, around off. Adair looks to cut it but misses.
A slower length delivery, outside off. Adair waits for it and late-cuts it to short third man.
A slower full ball on middle. Barry McCarthy pushes it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Now, Barry McCarthy gets into the act! Shorter and outside off. Barry McCarthy skips down the track and slaps it over mid off for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Mark Adair works it to mid-wicket for a single.
James Neesham is introduced into the attack.
Tossed up, on off. Adair skips down the track.and manages to push it towards long off for a single. 104 needed now from 48 balls!
A flatter one on middle, Adair goes back and blocks it.
SIX! Mark Adair is enjoying himself out there! Sodhi bowls a half-tracker on middle. Adair rocks back and pulls it all the way over the mid-wicket fence.
FOUR! Another boundary! Pushed quicker and tad shorter, around off. Adair looks to cut it. However, he gets a thick outside edge past short third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Clever from Adair! This is fuller on off. Adair reverse-sweeps it through the backward point region for a boundary.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Adair leaves it.
A fuller delivery again, on off. Barry McCarthy drives it to covers.
Tossed up, around off. Barry McCarthy pushes it back to the bowler.
On the shorter side, around off. Adair cuts it to point. The fielder there misfields and a single is taken.
Adair goes across the crease and Mitchell Santner bowls it wider outside off. Adair looks to sweep it but misses.
A flatter delivery angling into middle. Adair chops it to point.
FOUR! Well played! Tossed up on off. Adair skips down the track and plays an inside-out lofted drive over extra cover for a boundary.
Tosses this one up, full and outside off. Mark Adair drives it to long off for a single.
Short, a googly now, around middle and leg. Barry McCarthy flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Barry McCarthy walks out next.

OUT! TAKEN! The Irish batting collapse continues. Ish Sodhi might have not got a hat-trick but he has grabbed his third wicket of the game. It's Curtis Campher who departs now! Shorter one, around off, extra bounce there as well. Curtis Campher makes room and looks to slash this away. But the ball goes off the thick outside edge and lobs up towards backward point. James Neesham there once again, takes a good catch leaping towards his left.
Commentary.Howout: c James Neesham b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: Short again, outside off. Mark Adair pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
Quicker, shorter, outside off. Mark Adair looks to cut this away but he misses.
A low full toss, around off. Curtis Campher knocks it to long off for a single. No hat-trick for Ish Sodhi!
Short this time, around off. Mark Adair gets cramped for room there and ends up dabbing it to point.
Tosses it up, full and around off. Mark Adair pushes it towards cover.
Fuller now, outside off. Mark Adair taps it towards cover.
On the shorter side, around off. Adair punches it to the cover fielder.
WIDE! Drifts down the leg side again  Adair looks to clip it away but misses.
Wide! Down the leg side, shorter one. Mark Adair leaves it alone. Wide called!
Shorter one, spinning away, outside off. Curtis Campher pushes it towards cover off the back foot for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full, around middle. Curtis Campher steps down the ground and tonks it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Mark Adair walks out to the middle.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Oh, dear! Ireland lose another one! Two wickets in two balls for Ish Sodhi! What a first over this is from him! A loopy ball, full and spinning away, around off. George Dockrell looks to drive this away but he gets an outside edge towards first slip. James Neesham pouches it safely. Ish Sodhi will be on a hat-trick in his next over!
Commentary.Howout: c James Neesham b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: George Dockrell is the next man in.

OUT! STUMPED! Another one bites the dust! Ish Sodhi strikes this time and gets rid of Lorcan Tucker! Ireland have lost half their side now! A fuller ball, slower one again, outside off. Lorcan Tucker takes a big stride forward and looks to sweep this one but he misses. The ball hits him on the pads and goes towards the keeper. Dane Cleaver collects the ball and whips the bails off. Lorcan Tucker is well short of his crease. He walks back!
Commentary.Howout: st Dane Cleaver b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: Slower through the air, full and around off. Lorcan Tucker looks to reverse-sweep this one but he misses and gets hit on his body.
Shorter one now, spinning away, outside off. Curtis Campher makes room and punches it towards sweeper cover. Only a single.
Full, around off. Lorcan Tucker reverse-sweeps this towards cover-point and takes a quick single.
Sharp turn straightaway! Fuller one, a leg-break, outside off. Lorcan Tucker leans to drive but he gets beaten as the ball spins past his outside edge.
Ish Sodhi is into the attack now.
Outside off, fuller in length. Lorcan Tucker reverse-sweeps it towards short third man for a single.
Flighted delivery, full and on middle. Lorcan Tucker blocks it out.
Very full again, outside off. Curtis Campher drives it firmly towards sweeper cover for a single.
Pitches it up again, outside off. Curtis Campher makes room and looks to drive this one but the goes off the inside edge and rolls away towards the keeper.
Full again, on middle, tosses it up again. Curtis Campher defends it out solidly.
A fuller one, loopy ball as well, on the pads. Curtis Campher leans and blocks it out.
Mitchell Santner is back on.
On a length, around middle and leg. Lorcan Tucker tucks it towards square leg. Ireland are 41 for 4 at the end of the Powerplay!
Lorcan Tucker walks out next.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Jacob Duffy grabs another wicket. This time he sends back the Ireland skipper and the home side are 4 down within the Powerplay, once again. A fuller one, wide of off. Andy Balbirnie looks to drive this over cover and away from his body. But the ball goes off the outside edge back to the keeper. Dane Cleaver takes an easy catch there. Ireland in deep trouble!
Commentary.Howout: c Dane Cleaver b Jacob Duffy

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Good pick up! Short, around middle and leg. Andy Balbirnie pulls it gently towards fine leg for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! On a length, outside off, at 132.2 clicks. Andy Balbirnie looks to over mid off but he fails to get any connection on that.
Pulls his length back now, around middle. Curtis Campher tucks it off the back foot towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Nicley done! A fuller one, around off. Curtis Campher shuffles across and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Campher clips it to square leg for a single.
Bangs it short and around off. Campher looks to cut it but misses.
Back of a length, around off. It nips back in and Campher gets hit high on his pads as he looks to cut it away. The ball rolls towards the off side.
WIDE! Goes for a yorker again but spills it down the leg side. Campher looks to flick it away but misses.
Lands on a length, around off. Andy Balbirnie steers it towards third man for a single.
A yorker, around off. Andy Balbirnie squeezes it past point for a couple.
Curtis Campher comes to the crease.

OUT! RUN OUT! Ireland lose their third and this time it is courtesy of a run out. Tector tries to steal a single and pays a heavy price here. On a length, on middle. Tector looks to work it towards the leg side. However, he gets the leading edge towards covers. Tector sets off for a quick single and Glenn Phillips comes running in,collects the ball and fires a direct under-arm throw at the bowler's end. Tector is short of his crease and Ireland are in a big trouble here.
Run out chance! There is a direct throw at the bowler's end. The reply shows that Harry Tector is short of his ground. He has to walk back!
Goes fuller on middle. Andy Balbirnie pushes it to mid on.
On a length, on middle. Tector skips down the track and flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Tad shorter and around off. Andy Balbirnie dabs it towards deep point for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Tector punches it to point for a single. A risky single this one.
Harry Tector comes to the crease.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Gareth Delany departs for a golden duck! Duffy with a good-length delivery, around off. It nips back in sharply and Delany looks to push at it away from his body. The ball beats the inside edge of his blade and knocks over the off pole. Ireland are two down now and they need a solid partnership to make a match of this one.
Back of a length, around off. Andy Balbirnie looks to punch it away but gets the inside half of his blade towards mid off for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Lockie Ferguson draws first blood and gets the big wicket of Paul Stirling! It has been an intense battle between these two right throughout this tour and Lockie Ferguson gets the better of the hard-hitting Paul Stirling there! Good hard length, around off. Paul Stirling looks to heave it away towards the leg side. However, the ball hits him high on the blade, and the ball loops up in the air towards mid off. Mitchell Santner moves to his right and takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Santner b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: Gareth Delany walks out to bat at number 3.
WIDE! Bangs it short, around leg. Paul Stirling looks to pull it but misses.
Pulls his length back, on middle. Paul Stirling defends it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Paul Stirling is off the blocks quickly here! This is a half-volley, outside off. Paul Stirling drives and drives it well through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Paul Stirling punches it to cover-point.
Lands on a length, around off. Paul Stirling defends it with the angled blade towards point.
Overpitched delivery, around off. Paul Stirling drives it crisply towards the cover fielder in the ring.
Lockie Ferguson comes into the attck.
Duffy pulls his length back slightly, on middle again. Andy Balbirnie blocks it out.
Goes a tad fuller on middle. Andy Balbirnie drives it to mid on this time.
Angling into middle and leg. Paul Stirling clips it to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Nicely timed! Serves a fullish delivery on the pads. Paul Stirling flicks it past square leg for a boundary.
Lands on a length, on leg. Andy Balbirnie works it towards the leg side for a single.

On a length, angling into middle. Paul Stirling pushes it towards mid on. The ball hits high on the blade and ends up breaking the blade of Paul Stirling. He runs for a single though with just a handle and upper part of his blade, luckliy for him the fielder does not got to the ball quickly.
Who will bowl from the other end? Jacob Duffy it is!
Fraction short on middle. Paul Stirling works it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played again! This is fuller, on off. Paul Stirling goes inside-out this time and wide of extra-cover for a boundary.
Slower through the air, on off. Paul Stirling blocks it off the front foot.

SIX! Paul Stirling is off the mark in style! Perfect way to start for Ireland as well! Mitchell Santner drifts down the leg side, It is a tad short in length and Paul Stirling rocks back to pull it over the backward square leg fence for a biggie.
This is slower through the air, on middle. Paul Stirling with a solid block again.
A flatter one on off. Paul Stirling defends it off the front foot.
